spells.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
spells.description: Kog'Maw gains Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: Bio-Arcane Barrage applies its patch-ranked maximum-health magic damage to each successful basic attack for eight seconds. Bonus range and the monster cap are outside the champion-target calculation.
